replacements.from: test('exact dashboard tabs, shared states, native map and unit details work for Owner',async({page})=>{const {app,state}=await mount(page);await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-unit-row')).toHaveCount(3);await expect(app.getByLabel('Fleet status',{exact:true})).toHaveValue('all');await expect(app.getByRole('region',{name:'Fleet units in view',exact:true})).toBeVisible();await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-map-canvas .leaflet-tile').first()).toBeVisible();await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-stat-online strong')).toHaveText('1');await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-stat-offline strong')).toHaveText('1');await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-stat-online strong')).toHaveCSS('color','rgb(43, 255, 53)');await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-stat-offline strong')).toHaveCSS('color','rgb(255, 39, 52)');await expect(app.locator('.cos-fleet-stat-online')).toHaveCSS('background-image',/linear-gradient/);await page.screenshot({path:test.info().outputPath('integrated-fleet-overview.png'),fullPage:true});await app.locator('.cos-fleet-unit-row').filter({hasText:'Helios 1'}).click();const dialog=app.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Helios 1 unit intelligence'});await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();await dialog.locator('.cos-fleet-troubleshooting > summary').click();await expect(dialog.getByRole('button',{name:/mHelpDesk/}).first()).toBeVisible();await expect(dialog.getByRole('heading',{name:'Battery · Victron',exact:true})).toBeVisible();await dialog.getByRole('button',{name:'Close unit details'}).click();await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);expect(state.errors).toEqual([]);expect(state.calls.every(c=>c.method==='GET')).toBeTruthy();await page.screenshot({path:test.info().outputPath('integrated-fleet-dashboard.png'),fullPage:true});});
